tags.name: Cloud tenant settings
tags.description: Admin-tenant Cloud API endpoints. Require an active admin-tenant user, an admin-issued Cloud API bearer token with manage:tenant:self (or all), the global tenant-access policy, and the target organization's effective role scope. An allow-listed email alone never grants target access. Machine tokens and suspended users are refused. Nonoperators cannot access the admin target.

get.description: Requires target ReadData. Returns the existing tenant response envelope and terminates the route; subscription, invoice and checkout subpaths remain owned by billing. Does not mutate or provision data. The existing response's development subscription metadata is not an entitlement source.

200.description: Existing tenant envelope, including persisted id, name, tag, regionName and createdAt.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid Cloud bearer token, issuer or audience.

403.description: Caller, global access policy or target ReadData scope denied.

404.description: Target does not exist or admin target is concealed.

patch.description: Requires target ManageTenant. Accepts optional name and, for Console compatibility, an unchanged tag echo. Writes name only. Different tags are rejected before any write; a conditional tag predicate also rejects concurrent environment conversion without overwriting it. Environment and billing conversion remain separate operations. All other fields, including subscription, plan, quota, region and suspension, are rejected.

tag.description: Must equal the current stored tag; never written.

200.description: Existing tenant envelope with the actual persisted profile.

400.description: Invalid/unknown fields, different tag or concurrent environment conversion; no profile write on failure.

401.description: Invalid Cloud bearer token, issuer or audience.

403.description: Caller, global access policy or target ManageTenant denied.

get.description: Requires target ManageTenant. Reads the real admin-tenant organization t-{tenantId}. Missing tenant or organization is 404, never a fabricated false. No mutation, provisioning or entitlement/provider lookup on reads.

401.description: Invalid Cloud bearer token, issuer or audience.

403.description: Caller, global access policy or target ManageTenant denied.

404.description: Missing tenant/organization or concealed admin target.

patch.description: Requires target ManageTenant and explicit user Save. Updates only the admin-tenant organization t-{tenantId}. Enabling requires either the real tenant Development tag or the target SubscriptionLibrary.getSubscriptionData paid/enterprise plan via isReportablePlan. Missing/unavailable entitlement fails closed; synthetic tenant-response metadata never grants eligibility. Authorized disabling remains allowed without paid eligibility. No implicit writes or replay of failed requests. Profile and settings saves are separate: a client Promise.all is not cross-endpoint atomic.

400.description: Invalid body, nonboolean value, missing flag or unknown fields.

401.description: Invalid Cloud bearer token, issuer or audience.

403.description: Caller/global/target permission denied, or enabling is not eligible on the authoritative plan.

404.description: Missing tenant/organization, concealed admin target or concurrently changed environment.

503.description: Authoritative entitlement unavailable; auth.forbidden with data.reason=entitlement_unavailable. Nothing saved; retry only on fresh user intent.
